title: Sweet Caroline
notes: Released as a single on May 28, 1969. The inspiration was John F. Kennedy's daughter Caroline Kennedy, who was 11 years old at the time. In 2014 Diamond said the song was about his then-wife Marcia Murphey.

sections.name: Intro
sections.annotation: Horns and Keys, light drums & bass
